points.guidance: Official M1.  Method prerequisite for its dependent A criterion.

points.text: Of change of (magnetic) flux (linkage) or of cutting (magnetic) flux.
points.guidance: Official A1. Dependent on preceding M1. Method award: this method must be seen; it is a prerequisite for its associated accuracy award, subject to the official instructions.

points.text: (By Faraday’s law) changing flux induces e.m.f. in ring.
Current in ring causes field (around ring).
(By Lenz’s law) field around ring opposes field around coil.
